m.t: Pět set dolarů a tři body na vaší licenci.
m.e: Five hundred dollars and three points on your license.

m.e: If he doesn't continue this operation, he will lose his license.

m.t: Protože mám licenci na právo jen v téhle dimenzi, jasný?

m.e: Uh, yeah, because I wouldn't bring your amazing gift to this restaurant.

m.e: You didn't take her to the pool.

m.t: - Ještě jsem si je nevzala.
m.e: I hadn't taken it yet. What?

m.t: Nikdy by sis ji znovu nevzala. Vyhodila bys ji.

m.e: Did you bring any of those with you?

m.e: They called an hour ago asking for her whereabouts.

m.e: If we can just get the exact location, we can set up on them.

m.t: Povedlo se mi vystopovat signál, našel jsem hlavní polohu příjemce.
m.e: I was able to trace the signal, find the recipient's general location.

m.e: That would put her approximate location in this six-mile radius.

m.e: People, I think we just got a fix on the bad guys.

m.e: You just sent The Organization your exact location.

m.e: I have location for Walker and men to help in fight, but we have to leave now.

m.e: And is it safe to post your location like that?

m.e: Can you just confirm your location?

m.e: We were gonna wait until the kids were in college before we split up.

m.e: I will help you break up with her.

m.e: He's on the outside, like yours.

m.e: The inner dome will serve as support for the outer dome.

m.t: Jakožto vnější dodavatel, v tomhle nemáš žádnou moc.
m.e: As an outside contractor, you don't have a say in this.

m.e: And in your capacity as CEO, do you often review outside submissions for software ideas?

m.e: Look at the distal end of the left ulna.

m.t: Ale někdy je potřeba vnější perspektiva, abychom věci viděli jasně.
m.e: But sometimes it takes an outside perspective to see things clearly.

m.t: Tohle je to, co nabízí vnější svět.
m.e: This is what the outside world has to offer.
